credit: Tall gold-ground altarpiece: the Virgin enthroned holding the Christ Child, surrounded by eight angels, with four prophets beneath the throne.
Fresco of mourners around the dead Christ beneath a blue sky filled with grieving angels; a bare tree stands on a ridge at upper right.
Small gold-ground panel: the Virgin in a blue mantle holds the Child, surrounded by angels in blue robes on a flowered meadow.
Manuscript page of a crowded banquet: the duke in blue at a table laden with dishes, courtiers at left, a battle tapestry behind and a zodiac arc above.
A man in a dark fur-trimmed robe and a woman in a green dress stand hand in hand in a room with a red bed, a brass chandelier and a round mirror.
Embroidered scene on pale linen: Harold stands between two reliquaries with hands outstretched while William sits enthroned at left; Latin text above.
Mosaic of Christ with a cross-inscribed halo, raising one hand in blessing and holding a jewelled book, against a gold ground.
Tall stained-glass window: the crowned Virgin in blue holds the Child on her lap, against red glass, surrounded by panels of angels.

institution: The British Museum, London (also National Museum of Scotland)
credit: Display of small carved ivory chess figures — seated kings and queens, bishops and standing warders with shields.
Wide panel of mourners lowering the pale body of Christ from the cross; the Virgin in blue swoons in the foreground against a gold ground.
Gothic gold altarpiece: the kneeling angel Gabriel faces the seated Virgin who turns away, with a saint in each side panel.
Icon of the Virgin in a dark mantle pressing her face against the Christ Child, who embraces her neck, on a worn gold ground.
Wide fresco of a crowded medieval city: towers and houses above, dancers, traders and builders in the streets below.
Ornate gold altarpiece: richly dressed kings kneel before the Virgin and Child, followed by a long procession of horses and courtiers.

institution: Musée de Cluny – Musée national du Moyen Âge, Paris
credit: Tapestry on a red flower-strewn ground: a lady in front of a blue tent, a lion on the left and a unicorn on the right holding banners.
